findings.highlight: "Eh? Can you not see the end result? Can you not tell that my speed and destructive power have increased?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「え……？　シロウにも成否は判らないのですか？　その、外見的に鋭さが増したとか、破壊力が向上したとか伝わっていませんか……？」
findings.governingReading: Saber asks whether outward sharpness or destructive power provides a sign of success.
findings.explanation: Possible visible sharpness is replaced by a presupposed speed increase.
